description: Delete a soundboard sound, or several at once with sounds. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token deletes them.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

sounds.description: Several sounds to delete together, by name or ID, instead of sound.

name: delete_soundboard_sound
title: Delete soundboard sound
